context: Riku and Aoi compare game gear deals.
purpose: Casual register; daily vocabulary (ケース/モノ/セット/ビル/倍) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 新しいゲーム機、セットで買ったんだ!
lines.en: I bought the new console as a set!
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね、ケースも付いてたの?
lines.en: Nice, did it come with a case?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、ケースとソフトのセットだよ。
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ばらばらだと、倍したんじゃない?
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: そう、倍くらいするモノだったよ。
lines.en: Yeah, it was about twice the price.
lines.style: pleased teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: どのビルの店で、買ったの?
lines.en: Which building's shop did you buy at?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 駅前のビルの、ゲーム屋だよ。
lines.en: The game shop in the building by the station.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: セットで買うの、賢いモノの選び方だね!
lines.en: Buying as a set is a smart way to choose!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm closing delivery throughout
